・配信用ループアニメーション
・朝の支度中、ゆるっとふんわりポップなイメージ

Hello! I love your art style so much and was wondering if you could draw my Vtuber character SheRyu for me!!

【Character】
SheRyu is a wandering dragon and archaeologist who studies ancient and forbidden knowledge, regardless of how much danger it might come with. 
She is passionate about history, culture, and humanity and protecting and preserving knowledge.
Although she often appears as a soft and calm scholar, she has a lot of untapped hidden power within her that she sometimes loses control of if people she cares about are hurt. 
Her personality/lore is very similar to Nico Robin from One Piece (calm, mature, and kind scholar with a tragic past) but also incorporates some elements of Chopper from One Piece as well (honesty in expressions and can’t hide emotions), which can sometimes create a type of moe.
【Composition】
I would like the art to capture her calm, mature, scholar vibe but also her kindness and warmth (a lot like Robin from One Piece)! I leave the composition and the pose to you, but please use the same tan skin tone and the same hair color as the reference image! I would like it if you could keep her general color scheme but totally leave her hairstyle, outfit, and everything else up to your creative freedom!! 

【Usage】
I would like to share your wonderful art on my social media, like Youtube, Twitter, etc. and with credit to you!!
I would like the background, character, and signature layers separated.

Thank you so much for considering my request!! I hope you have a lovely day!!
Here are my references: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1saH4BCz3l1LPaO9XqHW_e1fNzp7fEB6O?usp=sharing
